mt4.title: MT4 Trading Platform
mt4.text: MetaTrader 4, often referred to as MT4, is a widely used and highly popular trading platform in the world of forex (foreign exchange) trading. It was developed by MetaQuotes Software and has become a standard choice for both novice and experienced traders.

mt5.title: MT5 Trading Platform
mt5.text: MetaTrader 5 is the next-generation multi-asset platform built for traders who need more. Faster execution, more timeframes, advanced order types, and native support for stocks and futures alongside forex and CFDs — all in one terminal.

download.title: Download Trading App
download.text: Trading with us gives you the best opportunity to invest your money in a smart and profitable way.

leverage.title: Dynamic Leverage
leverage.subtitle: Trade larger positions with smarter exposure control.
leverage.text: Leverage is one of the most important features of forex and CFD trading. It is a powerful tool that allows traders to gain greater exposure by opening positions that are significantly larger than the amount required to open the trade. To open positions, a trader is only required to have the margin requirement present in their trading account.

cards.title: Greater Market Exposure
cards.text: Control larger positions with smaller capital and take advantage of more trading opportunities.

cards.title: Amplify Potential Returns
cards.text: Leverage can magnify profits when the market moves in your favor.

cards.title: Understand Your Risk Exposure
cards.text: Leverage magnifies both potential gains and potential losses. Understanding your exposure before entering a position is essential to managing your risk effectively.

cards.title: Flexible Leverage Options
cards.text: Select the leverage that fits your strategy. Higher leverage increases both exposure and risk — our tools help you manage both.

swap.title: Swap Update
swap.text: Discover the latest swap rates and updates for Forex, Metals, Commodity, Energy, and Indices. Stay ahead in the markets with real-time insights and expert analysis at GTCFX. Maximize your trading potential today!

pamm.title: PAMM Account
pamm.text: A PAMM (Percentage Allocation Management Module) account is a popular investment tool in the world of forex trading. It is a specialized form of a managed account that allows individual investors to allocate their funds to a professional trader or money manager, who then trades on their behalf.
